lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2Ti10Ge20 (reduced formula NdTi5Ge10) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 119), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives tetrahedral Ti centers coordinated by four Ge neighbors, while Nd centers show 12 Ge neighbors and Ge centers adopt 9- or 12-neighbor environments. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ti tetrahedra, corner-sharing between Nd and Ti polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ge polyhedra.
